snippet.title: New Region Trailer │ The Game Awards │ ESCAPE FROM DUCKOV
snippet.description:
Escape From Duckov returns with a brand-new TGA trailer — watch our brave duckling venture into the new desert region teeming with eerie threats.​ The new region will arrive in 2026.

Will our duckling find a way to escape… or will it join the ranks of the hunted?  

👇 GRAB THE GAME HERE:​​
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167020/Escape_From_Duckov/
